translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Lukas
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I LUKAS

content: Alia manggau'kon mian sida baradosa
Yesus norobumo na murit-Na taena, “Sabole isian upa-upa men manggau'kon mian mangawawau dosa. Kasee silaka' a mian men manggau'kon mian sambana sida baradosa!
Porena bona mian iya'a kalu toure'na kootiion watu pinggiling
kasi ia tuongon waaro'o na tobui dako' ia manggau'kon mian men baasi parasaya kani'i mangawawau dosa.
Mbali' iya'a, maka'amat! Kalu utusmuu sa'angu' kaparasaya'an baradosa, bantili i ia. Kalu ia minsosol, ampuni i ia.
Mau mune' ia baradosa na ko'omuu piripitu' a sangilio, ka' piripitu' ia mule'kon na ko'omuu ka' mangaan taena, ‘Yaku' mintisala',’ ampuni i ia.”
Imaan men moonggor
Kasi poposuu' iya'a norobu ni Tumpu Yesus taena, “Tumpu, popomoonggor a imaanmai.”

Ia simbati Tumpu tae-Na, “Kalu i kuu imaanan mau tongko' koi kobalaki'na watuna sasawi, kuu sida morobu na kau ara kani'i taemuu, ‘Bi kobubut i koo ka' tontanom na tobui,’ ka' sabole kau iya'a bo mongololo' posuu'muu.”
Upa men tio limangonna ata'
“Too isian i kuu men montombonoi sa'angu' ata' men bapajeko na ale' kabai montotobo' domba. Kalu ata' iya'a mule'konmo, isian mbali' i kuu morobu na ko'ona, ‘Mai, kumaan kutung’?

Sabole sian! Kasee i kuu bo morobu na ata' iya'a taemuu, ‘Toropoti a kakaanku. Pamake pakean men moloe', ka' peperai pataka yaku' moko daa kumaan ka' ba'inum. Moko daasi iya'a kasi i koo sida kumaan.’
Ata' iya'a mosoo tunde'on gause ningilimangmo posuu'na tanaasna, taasi' koiya'a?
Koiya'a uga' i kuu. Kalu i kuu daamo nangawawau giigii' men niposuu'kon, bantilkon a koi kani'imari inta': ‘Kai tongko' ata' men sian kana'na. Kai tongko' nangawawau upa men tio wawauonmai.’ ”
Yesus nengelesi'i sompulo' mian men kustaon
Na rae'an mae' na Yerusalem, Yesus nosumalan na kosupuanna Samaria tia Galilea.
Tempo i Ia baasi minsoop na sa'angu' kampung, ia pootuungimo sompulo' mian men kustaon. Raaya'a potokerer na ko'oloaan,
ka' mangkakaro' taena, “Yesus! Guru! Kolingu'konon i kai!”
Tempo i Yesus nimiile' i raaya'a, Ia norobumo tae-Na, “Rae' na imam. Pa'ase' kada' i raaya'a mamaresa wakamuu.” Potorae' i raaya'a, kustana na'anumo.
Sarataa sa'angu' mian men isian na sompulo' mian iya'a ninginti'i se' kustana na'anumo, ia nomule'konmo ni Yesus ka' nuntunde' Alaata'ala tia wurung men kamporongoran.
Kasi ia nobanintuur na sarat ni Yesus ka' nobasukuur na Ko'ona. Mian iya'a samba Samaria.
Kasi i Yesus norobu tae-Na, “Taasi' isian sompulo' mian a men nilesi'i? Aanamo a men sio' mian iya'a?
Nongko'upa se' tongko' mian men sa'angu'an lipu' kani'i a nomule'kon ka' nuntunde' Alaata'ala?”
Kasi i Yesus norobu na mian iya'a tae-Na, “Kekerermo ka' rae'. Gause i koo mamarasaya i Yaku', mbaka' i koo nisalamatkonmo.”
Kotakaanna Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala

Toropii mian Farisi nimikirawar ni Yesus se' ipimo a kotakaanna Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala. Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Kotakaanna Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala sianta isian oosan men sida piile'onna mian,
pataka mian morobu taena, ‘Piile'! Ni'imo a Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala!’ kabai taena, ‘Piile'! Kara'amo a Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala!’ Gause Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala isian na ko'omuu.”
Noko daa koiya'a i Yesus norobumo na murit-Na tae-Na, “Bo taka tempona i kuu mingkira' mimiile' sangilio na tempona Anak Manusia, kasee i kuu sianmo mimiile'.
Mian bo morobu na ko'omuu taena, ‘Piile' itu'u! Isian i ia.’ Kabai taena, ‘Piile' ini'i! Isian i ia.’ Kasee i kuu alia umuar mansarak ka' lumolo' i ia.
Gause koikoimo tia bongki-bongkit tumilep ringkat na puusna langit pataka puusna langit, koiya'a uga' ni'imarian na iliona kotakaanna Anak Manusia.
Kasee i Ia tio mungurumpaki kutung biai' repaan ka' sian labotionna mian men tumuo' na tempo koini'i.
Koi men nosida na tempo ni Nuh, koiya'a uga' a men bo sida ni'imarian na iliona kotakaanna Anak Manusia.
Mian kumaan ka' ba'inum, mosuo' ka' mompoposuo' anakna. Koiya'a pataka na ilio ninsoopan ni Nuh na lalomna kapal ka' tano' balaki' ia limbusi weer ka' ninsilaka'i i raaya'a giigii'.
Koiya'a uga' na tempo ni Loot. Mian kumaan ka' ba'inum, mobaluk ka' mingili, mo'ale' ka' mangawawau laigan.
Kasee tempo i Loot no'umuar na Sodom, na ilio iya'a no'usanmo apu tia balerang nda'amari langit ninsilaka'i raaya'a giigii'.
Koiya'a uga' ni'imarian na iliona Anak Manusia pipiile'konon.
Na ilio iya'a mian men monda'a na wawona laiganna, alia mangala upana men isian na lalomna laiganna. Koiya'a uga' a mian men isian na ale', alia mule'kon na laiganna.
Inau' a upa men nosida na boroki' ni Loot!
Mian men mampari-pari mansalamatkon wakana na dunia kani'i sian mantausi tutuo' men pore. Kasee mian men mongorookon wakana na Ingku', ia bo mantausi tutuo' men pore.
Bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' na malom iya'a rua' mian pototokol na sa'angu' tokolan, sa'angu' bo wawaon ka' men sa'angu' bo parereion.
Rua' wiwine pintanga' minggiling gandum. Sa'angu' bo wawaon, ka' men sa'angu' bo parereion. [
Rua' mian pintanga' balimang na ale'. Sa'angu' bo wawaon, ka' men sa'angu' bo parereion.]”
Murit ni Yesus nimikirawar taena, “Tumpu! Maana a men bo sidaanna men koiya'a?” Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Aana a men isian bangke, ino'o moriwut a sapu' men mangkaan bangke.”

footnotes.text: watu pinggiling: watu malempat balaki' ka' marawat men bo pinggilingna mian gandum mbaripian men kakariorkononna sapi' a pulu'na.
